title: scGNN is a novel graph neural network framework for single-cell RNA-Seq analyses.
summary: The primary study’s scGNN integrates single-cell RNA-seq modalities and reports Alzheimer’s disease-associated oligodendrocyte-subcluster shifts, gene/pathway enrichments and cell-specific regulatory programs. This is an exploratory reanalysis of existing data, not causal or independently experimentally confirmed biology.
ai_technology: Author/university full primary PDF, Methods/Results and Nature record checked: GSE138852, 13,214 nuclei from six AD and six control brains. Correction dated 2022-05-04 only swaps figure panels and does not alter the result.
